content.short: Eco Portal enables apps to accept any stablecoin across networks.
content.description: Eco Portal serves as a stablecoin liquidity layer for on-chain applications and protocols, providing a practical means to move stablecoins across multiple networks. It enables easy cross-chain transfers between Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, and Polygon at a single, low fee. The portal offers a clean, straightforward interface for cross-chain stable sends and acts as a concrete example of how Eco Routes can support smooth, cross-network liquidity flows within on-chain apps.
content.meta: Eco Portal is a DeFi tooling platform enabling cross-chain stablecoin transfers. Discover Eco Portal and other DeFi Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
